Location

Discover the charm of 1254 Fteley Avenue in Soundview, a residential Bronx neighborhood surrounded by everyday conveniences and local amenities. Located near Westchester Avenue and East 172nd Street, residents are close to neighborhood grocery stores, delis, restaurants, schools, and local parks, with Crotona Park and Soundview-area waterfront green spaces offering opportunities for recreation and outdoor activities. The nearby 6 train stations at Morrison Avenue–Sound View Avenue and St. Lawrence Avenue, along with local bus service, make commuting throughout the Bronx and to Manhattan convenient.
